title: RECYCLE | floppydisks
excerpt: We recycle old floppy disks and buy new floppy ones.
content_html:
We buy new disks in sealed undamaged packs.  Quantities of 100 or more.

If disks are outside their original packaging, we cannot treat them as new.

  For new disks, send us a picture of your disks,
and call (800) 397-7890 for a quote.

RECYCLING 3.5" FLOPPY DISKS:   

​

We accept any quantity of diskettes.  

If you send more than 200 disks, we offer a small shipping offset.  

Send your discs to:

​

Floppydisk Recycle Program 

668 North Coast HWY #1117

Laguna Beach CA 92651

To get a shipping rebate, please include our reimbursement form.

Reimbursement rules are on the form.

Click here, for a copy of the form.

​
